lines.text: An ant takes three random steps on a cube.
lines.caption: An ant takes three random steps on a cube.

lines.text: Can it reach the far corner?
lines.caption: Can it reach the far corner?

lines.text: An ant starts at corner A, and walks a random edge each minute.
lines.caption: An ant starts at corner A, and walks a random edge each minute.

lines.text: What's the chance it's at the far corner G after three minutes?
lines.caption: What's the chance it's at the far corner G after three minutes?

lines.text: G is three edges away. So every step must go farther.
lines.caption: G is three edges away. So every step must go farther.

lines.text: Step one: all three edges go farther. That's three out of three.
lines.caption: Step one: all three edges go farther. That's three out of three.

lines.text: Step two: only two out of three go farther.
lines.caption: Step two: only two out of three go farther.

lines.text: Step three: only one out of three reaches G.
lines.caption: Step three: only one out of three reaches G.

lines.text: One, times two thirds, times one third. That's two ninths!
lines.caption: One, times two thirds, times one third. That's two ninths!
